paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, David a-inn a a-om lai in zawlnei Nathan kiang ah David in, "Ngai in, kei sidar sing inn ah ka om a, himahleh TOUPA thukhun bawm puanzak nuai maimah ah a-om a," achi hi.
heading: David Kiang A Nathan Thuchiam / (2 Sam 7.1-17)
english: When David was living in his house, David said to Nathan the prophet, “Behold, I live in a cedar house, but the ark of Yahweh’s covenant is in a tent.”

paite: Nathan in David kiang ah, "Na lungsim a na vei bangtak in hih in; Pathian na kiang ah lah a-om ngal a," achi hi.
english: Nathan said to David, “Do all that is in your heart; for God is with you.”

paite: Huai zan mah in hichi ahong hi a, Nathan kiang ah Pathian thu ahong tung hi,
english: That same night, the word of God came to Nathan, saying,

paite: "Ka sikha David va hilh in, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: 'Ka omna ding in nang inn na hon lamsak ding ahi kei;
english: “Go and tell David my servant, ‘Yahweh says, “You shall not build me a house to dwell in;

paite: Israel suante Aigupta gam a kipan ka pikhiak a kipan tutan in inn lam ah ka om kei a; puanin leh biakbuk ah ka om zel hi.
english: for I have not lived in a house since the day that I brought up Israel to this day, but have gone from tent to tent, and from one tent to another.

paite: Israel tengteng toh ka paina himhim uah leng ka mite vak ding a thu ka piak Israelte vaihawmte kiang ah, bangziak a sidar sing inn hon lamsak lou, ka chi ngei a hia?'
english: In all places in which I have walked with all Israel, did I speak a word with any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to be shepherd of my people, saying, ‘Why have you not built me a house of cedar?’”’

paite: "Huaiziak in ka sikha David kiang ah huchi in gen in, Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi, belam tatna mun a kipan na belamching lai ka mi Israelte tung a kumpipa ding in ka hon la a;
english: “Now therefore, you shall tell my servant David, ‘Yahweh of Armies says, “I took you from the sheep pen, from following the sheep, to be prince over my people Israel.

paite: na paina peuhmah ah na kiang ah ka om zel a, na melmate ka hon hihmansak zel hi; lei a mithupi mahmahte bang in min thupitak ka hon bawlsak sin hi.
english: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and have cut off all your enemies from before you. I will make you a name like the name of the great ones who are on the earth.

paite: Ka mi Israelte a ding in mun ka sepsak ding a, kisuan nawn lou a amau tuam mun a a-om gige theihna ding un amaute ka phutkip ding a, tuma lam a bang in, migiloute'n amaute ahihgenthei nawn kei ding uh;
english: I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in their own place, and be moved no more. The children of wickedness will not waste them any more, as at the first,

paite: ka mi Israelte tung a vaihawmte ka seh hun a kipan. Huan na melma tengteng leng ka zahlaksak lai ding hi. Huai lou leng TOUPA'N inn khat ahon lamsak lai ding chih ka hon hilh ahi.
english: and from the day that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. I will subdue all your enemies. Moreover I tell you that Yahweh will build you a house.

paite: Huchi in na ni abei a, na pi-le-pute kiang a na pai hun chiang in, hichi ahi ding a, na nung a na suan na tapate lak a mi ka tungding ding a; agam ka hihkip ding hi.
english: It will happen, when your days are fulfilled that you must go to be with your fathers, that I will set up your offspring after you, who will be of your sons; and I will establish his kingdom.

paite: Ama'n inn ahon lamsak ding a; alaltutphah tangtawn in ka hihkip ding.
english: He will build me a house, and I will establish his throne forever.

paite: Huchi in apa ka hi ding a, amah ka tapa ahi ding; ka zahngaihna na ma a ompa a kipan a ka lakmang bang in, amah zaw ka lamang kei ding hi;
english: I will be his father, and he will be my son. I will not take my loving kindness away from him, as I took it from him who was before you;

paite: Ka inn ah leh ka gam ah amah tangtawn in ka dingkipsak ding a, alaltutphah tangtawn a hihkip ahi ding," chi in.
english: but I will settle him in my house and in my kingdom forever. His throne will be established forever.”’”

paite: Huai thute tengteng leh huai kilakna bang geih in Nathan in David kiang ah agen hi.
english: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so Nathan spoke to David.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa David alut a, TOUPA ma ah atu a, "Aw TOUPA Pathian, kua ahia ka hih a, ka inkote leng kua ahia ahih ua, hichi tantan na hon pi?
heading: David Kipahthu Genna Thumna / (2 Sam 7.18-29)
english: Then David the king went in and sat before Yahweh; and he said, “Who am I, Yahweh God, and what is my house, that you have brought me this far?

paite: Aw Pathian, huaite leng nang mitmuh in thil neuchik phet zaw ahi a; himahleh aw TOUPA Pathian, na sikha inkuan hong omdan ding thu kum tampi sung a ding na na genta a, milian bang in na hon sep lai a, aw TOUPA Pathian.
english: This was a small thing in your eyes, O God, but you have spoken of your servant’s house for a great while to come, and have respected me according to the standard of a man of high degree, Yahweh God.

paite: Na sikha pahtawi a a-om tungtang thu ah David in na kiang ah bang agen tuan nawn dia? Na sikha lah na theitel mahmah hi.
english: What can David say yet more to you concerning the honor which is done to your servant? For you know your servant.

paite: Aw TOUPA na sikha ziak in nangmah lungsim a pawt bang zel in hiai thil thupi mahmah theisak ding in thil thupi mahmahte na hihta hi.
english: Yahweh, for your servant’s sake, and according to your own heart, you have done all this greatness, to make known all these great things.

paite: Aw TOUPA ka theih un nang bang mahmah a-om kei ua, nang lou ngal Pathian himhim leng a-om sam kei hi.
english: Yahweh, there is no one like you, neither is there any God besides you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

paite: Aigupta gam a kipan na tatkhiak a na mite ma a namdangte zahlaksak a, thil thupitak leh lauhuaitak hih a min thupitak bawlsak ding a Pathian in amah mite a dia ahon tatkhiak na mi Israelte bang mahmah leitung ah namdang kua a-om ua?
english: What one nation on the earth is like your people Israel, whom God went to redeem to himself for a people, to make you a name by great and awesome things, in driving out nations from before your people whom you redeemed out of Egypt?

paite: Na mi Israelte tangtawn a na mite ding in lah na bawlta ngal a; nang TOUPA amaute Pathian na hita hi.
english: For you made your people Israel your own people forever; and you, Yahweh, became their God.

paite: "Huchi in aw TOUPA, na sikha tungtang thu leh a-inkote tungtang thu na gen tangtawn a ding in hihkip inla, na gensa bang in hih in.
english: Now, Yahweh, let the word that you have spoken concerning your servant, and concerning his house, be established forever, and do as you have spoken.

paite: Tangtawn in na min hihkip leh hihlet in om hen, 'Sepaihte' TOUPA Israel' Pathian, Israelte a dia Pathian mahmah ahi,' na sikha David inkote na ma ah hihkip in om uhen," chi in.
english: Let your name be established and magnified forever, saying, ‘Yahweh of Armies is the God of Israel, even a God to Israel. The house of David your servant is established before you.’

paite: "Aw nang ka Pathian, na sikha kiang ah inkuan na dingsak ding chih na na puangta ngal a; huaiziak in na sikha in na kiang ah ka thum ngam lai ahi.
english: For you, my God, have revealed to your servant that you will build him a house. Therefore your servant has found courage to pray before you.

paite: Aw TOUPA, nang zaw Pathian na hi a, hiai thil hoih na sikha na chiamta hi.
english: Now, Yahweh, you are God, and have promised this good thing to your servant.

paite: Na sikha inkote na ma a tangtawn a a-om gige theihna ding un na vualzawl a; aw TOUPA, na vualzawl zaw tangtawn a vualzawlna ahi,” achi hi.
english: Now it has pleased you to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue forever before you; for you, Yahweh, have blessed, and it is blessed forever.”
